newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers drift down on NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers drift down on NYMEX.

text.p: North American bunker prices drifted down late this week in line with the bearish tone on NYMEX and mediocre demand, players said on Thursday.
"We came up earlier this week, but there is not a real big buying interest," said one New York Harbor trader, referring to small moves Monday and Tuesday due to shipping demand.
The market, however, is still hanging on to about 50 percent of the gains made earlier this month following the freeze in Europe.
